title: Does Brian want to play it?

criteria.claim: A made-up word played in Word mode sounds like one word, not separate pieces.
criteria.question: Play 'kaa lu mi nos' in Word mode. 1 = separate pieces, 5 = one sung word.

criteria.claim: Brian wants to keep playing it.
criteria.question: After ten minutes of playing: 1 = done with it, 5 = want more.
